mission_statement: Autonom drift, kvalitetssäkring, bildgranskning och hosting av Trendcarpet Photo QA Hub för mattor, hattar och Reforma-möbelkataloger via permanent webb-UI (trendcarpet-qa.vercel.app).

scope_jail.strict_rule: NO recursive scans over unindexed cloud or OneDrive directories.

checkerboard_transparency.description: Implemented repeating-conic-gradient (#cbd5e1 / #ffffff) for stage backdrop, angle cards, shot boxes and lightbox to reveal transparent RGBA studio cutout edges.

reforma_manifest_integration.description: Added products_manifest.json support in hatshop_server.py with 270 products and 1649 images.
